summary: Small Java programs that ran inside a web page, launched with Java in 1995. They promised rich apps in the browser years before JavaScript could deliver, but were slow to start and a constant security risk, and browsers stopped running them.

image.alt: A Java applet running in a web page

events.note: Introduced with the first release of Java.

events.label: Plug-ins go
events.note: Major browsers begin removing the plug-in system applets need.
Java 11 removes the appletviewer tool, so the JDK can no longer run applets.
The unused Applet API stays in Java until JDK 26 removes it.

cause: Browsers dropped plug-ins, and the applet launcher was removed from Java.

sources.title: OpenJDK JEP 504: Remove the Applet API
